purpose: config_setting(values) on the deprecated pre-platforms flags cpu, host_cpu and crosstool_top (ConfigSetting.DEPRECATED_PRE_PLATFORMS_FLAGS, rules/config/ConfigSetting.java:95-97, 420-482): value conversion through AutoCpuConverter and the LabelConverter with a null conversion context, the main-repository-only deprecation warning and its position, conversion errors, the --cpu/--host_cpu/--crosstool_top command-line options (output roots, exec transition, query). Motivation: @protobuf//build_defs:config_android-legacy-default-crosstool (values = {crosstool_top: //external:android/crosstool}) blocked every analysis depending on @protobuf//:protoc.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; default registry (bcr.bazel.build); one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (platforms extracted from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Native stdout/outputs paths are below the action output root (`.../outputs/`).
comparison (tests/pre_platforms_flags.rs: success equal (genuine exit 0 <=> native exit 0); WARNING lines equal per config_setting (each setting's warnings in order; Skyframe evaluates different config_settings in parallel, so their relative order is not deterministic in Bazel) and other warnings in order; every warning before the first error; Bazel's first ERROR message (an external repository's location reduced to its BUILD file name) ends a native stderr line; built outputs (path below bazel-out -> contents) equal; query stdout equal.
genuine_key_findings: Main-repository config_setting on cpu/host_cpu/crosstool_top: `WARNING: <WS>/pkg/BUILD.bazel:L:C: in config_setting rule //pkg:NAME: select() on FLAG is deprecated. Use platform constraints instead: https://bazel.build/docs/configurable-attributes#platforms.`, once per setting and flag (also when analyzed in the target and the exec configuration), before `INFO: Analyzed target`.
External config_settings (@ext//:..., like @protobuf//build_defs's) never warn; a main-repository setting selected from @ext warns (ext_p_main).

The warning precedes the rule's errors even when the failing entry comes first (error_then_cpu): Skyframe reports warnings at once and replays errors after the function (SkyFunctionEnvironment.java:816-837, Event.storeForReplay).

crosstool_top values: `@bazel_tools//tools/cpp:toolchain` and `@@...` match the default; `pkg:t` is `//pkg:t`; `:t` is `//:t` (not the setting's package); `//pkg:t` in @ext names the MAIN repository; `@ext//:t` names canonical repo `ext` and never matches --crosstool_top=@ext//:t (`@@ext+//:t` does): Label.parseCanonical (null conversion context).

cpu: `{"cpu": ""}` matches by default (AutoCpuConverter: empty is the host CPU k8); --cpu=arm builds into bazel-out/arm-fastbuild; --cpu=k8 and --cpu= are the default configuration; --cpu=a/b: `ERROR: CPU/Platform descriptor 'a/b' is invalid as part of a path: must not contain /` (exit 2).
Exec configuration: --cpu = the parent's --host_cpu (k8-opt-exec by default and with --cpu=arm; ppc-opt-exec with --host_cpu=ppc).

Conversion errors: `While parsing option --crosstool_top=a:b:c: invalid target name 'b:c': target names may not contain ':'`, `--crosstool_top=: invalid target name '': empty target name` (command line exit 2; config_setting attribute error exit 1); --crosstool_top=@nope//:x is accepted (NO_OP option, never resolved).
known_divergences: Exit codes of command-line errors: genuine 2, native 1 (native's single error channel); success/failure always agrees.

Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH` on stdout, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`) and no INFO lines. Native analysis warnings (these and every other analysis warning, engine-wide and pre-existing) are printed once the build returns, so they keep their order relative to errors and to the loading-phase pattern warning, but an executed action's logs precede them, while genuine reports them during analysis; the fixture's actions print nothing, and under --nobuild nothing executes.
External repository locations: genuine `<OB>/external/ext+/BUILD.bazel:37:15`, native the local_path_override directory `<WS>/ext/BUILD.bazel:37:15` (line and column equal).

The relative order of warnings from different config_settings (all_default, all_set, exec_host_cpu_ppc) differs: genuine's is Skyframe's parallel evaluation order, native's the deterministic analysis order.
Native needs --experimental-builtin-modules for the exec cases (the default host platform's @platforms//host); it is passed in every native case.
